{
  "name": "repo-quiz",
  "version": "0.2.1",
  "description": "After each reply, a sidebar asks an interview-style question or shares a grounded fact about the repository you are working in.",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "author": {
    "name": "lukeismith"
  },
  "license": "GPL-3.0-or-later",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/lukeismith/lukes-claudecode-mods/tree/main/repo-quiz",
  "userConfig": {
    "questionsPerHour": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Questions per hour",
      "description": "The most interview questions started per repository in any hour. 0 means facts only.",
      "options": [
        "0",
        "1",
        "2",
        "3",
        "4",
        "6",
        "8",
        "12"
      ],
      "default": "4"
    },
    "rapidReplyMinutes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Rapid reply window (minutes)",
      "description": "When your messages come closer together than this many minutes, a fact appears instead of a question. 0 turns the rule off.",
      "options": [
        "0",
        "1",
        "2",
        "3",
        "5",
        "10"
      ],
      "default": "3"
    },
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "What to show",
      "description": "Questions and facts, questions only, or facts only.",
      "options": [
        "questions and facts",
        "questions only",
        "facts only"
      ],
      "default": "questions and facts"
    },
    "refresherEvery": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Refresher question every",
      "description": "Every Nth question is about code that has not changed in a while. 0 means never.",
      "options": [
        "0",
        "2",
        "3",
        "4",
        "5",
        "10"
      ],
      "default": "3"
    },
    "refresherMinAgeDays": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Refresher minimum age (days)",
      "description": "How many days a file must go unchanged to count as refresher material.",
      "options": [
        "7",
        "14",
        "30",
        "60",
        "90",
        "180",
        "365"
      ],
      "default": "30"
    },
    "difficulty": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Difficulty",
      "description": "The interview bar the questions aim for.",
      "options": [
        "collegiate",
        "senior",
        "staff"
      ],
      "default": "senior"
    },
    "categories": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Question categories",
      "description": "Comma-separated categories to rotate through, or \"all\". The categories are: architecture, how code works, system design, debugging, language semantics, concurrency, testing, security, performance, data modeling.",
      "default": "all"
    },
    "flawReview": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Flaw review",
      "description": "Show a \"possible flaw\" callout when the research behind a card exposes a real problem in the code.",
      "default": true
    },
    "sourcePolicy": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Documentation sources",
      "description": "Whether cards may cite well-regarded unofficial pages when no official documentation covers a point.",
      "options": [
        "official preferred",
        "official only"
      ],
      "default": "official preferred"
    },
    "excludePaths": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Excluded paths",
      "description": "Comma-separated glob patterns for files never used as a question's focus, such as \"generated/**, *.pb.swift\", or \"none\".",
      "default": "none"
    },
    "questionModel": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Question model",
      "description": "Writes each question and its model answer. Each choice uses the newest model of that family your Claude Code knows.",
      "options": [
        "haiku",
        "sonnet",
        "opus"
      ],
      "default": "opus"
    },
    "questionEffort": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Question effort",
      "description": "How hard the question model thinks. Lower is faster and cheaper.",
      "options": [
        "low",
        "medium",
        "high"
      ],
      "default": "high"
    },
    "factModel": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fact model",
      "description": "Writes each batch of \"Did you know?\" facts.",
      "options": [
        "haiku",
        "sonnet",
        "opus"
      ],
      "default": "sonnet"
    },
    "gradeModel": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Grading model",
      "description": "Grades your typed answer when you press Grade.",
      "options": [
        "haiku",
        "sonnet",
        "opus"
      ],
      "default": "sonnet"
    },
    "steWriting": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Simplified Technical English",
      "description": "Ask the models to write in a plain style based on ASD-STE100: one idea per sentence, the active voice, simple tenses and plain words.",
      "default": true
    },
    "dailyBudgetUsd": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Daily budget (USD)",
      "description": "Estimated API-equivalent spend per day, in US dollars, after which repo-quiz stops starting model runs.",
      "options": [
        "no limit",
        "0.50",
        "1",
        "2",
        "5",
        "10",
        "20"
      ],
      "default": "no limit"
    },
    "openPaneOnStart": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Open the pane at start",
      "description": "Open the sidebar when a session starts. /repo-quiz always opens it.",
      "default": true
    },
    "toastOnNewQuestion": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Notify on a new question",
      "description": "Show a toast when a new question is ready and the pane is hidden.",
      "default": true
    },
    "statusLine": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Status line",
      "description": "Show repo-quiz's state and today's estimated cost in the status line.",
      "default": true
    },
    "telemetry": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Local telemetry",
      "description": "Records kept on this machine for the Stats view. \"counts only\" keeps no text you typed and no card content; \"full\" also keeps both, for reviewing quality later.",
      "options": [
        "counts only",
        "full",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "counts only"
    }
  }
}
